capabilities: Render Markdown quiz blocks as interactive cards
Grade single-choice, multiple-choice, matching, fill-in-the-blank, and short-answer questions
Write attempt records and statistics into the source note
Practise selected question banks in a sidebar window
Reference questions by id in other notes
extras: Attempt write-back rewrites the note on every answer, which can cause Git churn or Sync conflicts; write-back can be disabled. The AI authoring skill is optional.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quiz practice, so questions and attempt records are separated from the notes they belong to.
summary: Markdown-native quiz plugin that renders question blocks as interactive cards and writes attempt records back into the note.
